test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 3 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the term that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

O2F, R5H, U10J, X17L, ?
solution:
According to the English alphabet and its positional values:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81cdf80de714ffb652c965684cbc295b014d05a2cb1e0ccec7d5ea5b63fe354d.png] 

The pattern followed in the given series is:

 
• First alphabet increase by 3 positional values.
 
• Numbers increase by 2 from the previous number.
 
• Last alphabet increase by 2 positional values.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a985df2c8d4d9bd44f416fc6234feb93559ff3247505e07f7b8419f407327de.png] 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4).**
